topic: Silent-Ignore Cohort — verification of ISS-2676 (provenance date) + ISS-2686 (silent-day recompute to 2026-06-10 basis)
our_argument_summary: Section 6.15 documents the silent-ignore cohort: twelve dome predictions whose test windows closed with zero dome-posted results. Eleven are dome_silent_terminal (past the 14-day silence rule); PRED-073 (closed 2026-05-31) is dome_silent pending its 2026-06-14 threshold. Our verdicts: nine standard_physics/recycled, two tacit_withdrawal, one falsified (PRED-073, with fairness caveat).

patches.target: single as-of basis for silent-day counts

ISS-2676.evidence: sections.json part6.html now reads: zero results posted '(dome predictions page last confirmed clear 2026-06-10 by automated poller; data/predictions.json:PRED-073; data/predictions.json:PRED-105)'. Cross-checked against monitor/status.json: last_poll=2026-06-10T00:08:06Z, all 6 page hashes byte-identical to baselines, zero manual commits (drought ~53.5d). The provenance claim is accurate and traceable — the poller did run on 2026-06-10 and did confirm the dome surface unchanged. Table header also carries the basis: 'silence counts as of 2026-06-10'.

ISS-2686.evidence: All twelve rows recomputed to a single 2026-06-10 basis. Arithmetic verified exactly: 2026-04-30 closures -> 41d (8 rows), 2026-04-11 -> 60d (PRED-072/084), 2026-04-18 -> 53d (PRED-105), 2026-05-31 -> 10d (PRED-073). Zero stale 39d/59d/51d/8d strings remain in sections.json or docs/index.html. Prose 'now 60 days silent' matches table. predictions.json statuses match the table 12/12 (11x dome_silent_terminal, PRED-073 dome_silent) and our_verdict column matches 12/12. docs/index.html rebuilt in the same commit — no build drift (41d x8, 53d x1, 60d x2, 10d x1, provenance line x1).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: n/a — verification pass on our own section, not dome code. Dome-side fact relied on: poller confirms dome predictions page hashes unchanged through 2026-06-10, i.e. no results posted for any cohort member.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Silent-day counts are a declared fixed snapshot (as-of 2026-06-10), now internally consistent — the prior mixed-basis problem (39d/51d/8d vs 59d) is gone.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: Fairness caveat for PRED-073 retained — correctly scoped (falsified verdict rests on secular-rate null, not post-window observation).
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None found in the section text. One bookkeeping discrepancy found in closed-issues.json (see holes_found[0]).

holes_found.description: ISS-2686 was closed with a verification_pattern that does not pass: it checks part6.html.includes('as of 2026-06-10') but the actual inserted text uses non-breaking spaces ('as of 2026-06-10'). The plain-space variant occurs nowhere in part6.html (verified false at HEAD 17b972e). The patch itself is correct; the recorded regression check is broken and will false-fail if integrity/tinker ever executes it.
holes_found.recommendation: Decider: update ISS-2686.verification_pattern in closed-issues.json to match the   variant (or test for 'silence counts as' plus '2026-06-10' separately). No section edit needed.

holes_found.description: Carry-over (c3 H2, second clause — the part ISS-2686 did NOT cover): PRED-073 crosses the section's own 14-day silence rule on 2026-06-14 (window closed 2026-05-31). At that point a coordinated update is required: row status dome_silent -> dome_silent_terminal, the fairness caveat, and the scoreboard-tally sentence. No open issue, expansion-tracker entry, or other work item tracks this dated follow-up (verified: zero PRED-073/06-14 matches in open-issues.json and expansion-tracker.json at HEAD). The poller heartbeat tracks the d-count but nothing routes the 06-14 edit to the decider.
holes_found.recommendation: Decider: create a dated follow-up issue (due 2026-06-14) for the coordinated PRED-073 terminal-crossing update so the row, caveat, and tally move together. Mechanically cheap; failing to do it on time hands a dome defender a 'their own table violates their own 14-day rule' jab.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome author's scoreboard discipline is at least consistent in one direction: every listed prediction did get a registered window-close date on the dome side before going silent (data/predictions.json:PRED-087..106 window metadata), so our cohort table is built on the dome's own registration data, not our reconstruction.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Registering windows and then never posting results is exactly the asymmetry the section documents — twelve closed windows, zero posted results (sections.json:part6 section 6.15 scoreboard tally, poller-confirmed clear 2026-06-10). A scoreboard that only records hits is not a track record.

summary_for_decider: Both queue-516 patches VERIFIED ACCURATE: ISS-2676 provenance line is correct and matches poller evidence (last_poll 2026-06-10T00:08:06Z, hashes unchanged); ISS-2686 recompute is arithmetically exact on a single 2026-06-10 basis, consistent across sections.json, docs/index.html, and predictions.json. Section text needs no edit. Two minor bookkeeping holes: (1) ISS-2686 recorded verification_pattern false-fails on   entities — fix the pattern string in closed-issues.json; (2) carry-over hole detected but no matching open-issue found — decider should create one: dated follow-up (due 2026-06-14) for the PRED-073 dome_silent -> dome_silent_terminal crossing (c3 H2 recommended tracking this; the staleness half was fixed, the tracking half was not).
deeper_analysis: Verification methodology: (1) extracted the exact 3eb437a diff to part6.html via JSON-aware diff — changes are precisely the two patches plus nothing else (no collateral edits, no silent content drift); (2) recomputed every silent-day figure from window-close dates against 2026-06-10 — all four cohorts exact (41/60/53/10); (3) traced the provenance claim to monitor/status.json poller output rather than taking the date on faith — the poller genuinely polled 2026-06-10T00:08:06Z and found all six page hashes baseline-identical, which is what 'confirmed clear' requires; (4) cross-checked predictions.json status and our_verdict fields against all 12 table rows — 12/12 match; (5) confirmed build output (docs/index.html) carries the new values with zero stale strings — the PRED-073-style build-drift failure mode from 2026-05-24 did not recur. Adversarial angle considered: could a defender attack the 'confirmed clear' wording as overclaiming (poller checks page hashes, not a semantic no-results parse)? No — unchanged hashes against baselines known to contain no results entail no new results; the inference chain is sound. The remaining exposure is temporal, not factual: the snapshot date now ages visibly, and the PRED-073 06-14 crossing is 4 days out with no tracking item (holes_found[1]).
